baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive فُتِحَتْ, singular sky, resultative فَكَانَتْ, and plural أَبْوَابًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A closed overhead cover is acted upon, and the result predicate identifies its new state as a plurality of entrances. The wording presents transformation of the sky's continuous surface, not merely the opening of doors already located in it.

activation_trace.role: Opening a closed thing into a widened aperture supplies the physical transformation of the sky-cover.
The overhead sky as a covering surface supplies the material that is opened.
Temporal occurrence and predication make the doors the sky's resulting state.
Entrances or doors supply the plural apertures into which the sky is transformed.

changed_reading.before: The sky is opened and doors in it become available.
changed_reading.after: The sky's formerly continuous cover is itself reconstituted as many traversable apertures.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فُتِحَتْ as an opening beginning and أَبْوَابًا as entrances or limits.
baseline_models.mechanism: Opening can initiate what follows, while a door can be both an entrance and a frontier. The sky's new plurality therefore functions as a set of thresholds that commences a new regime rather than as damage with no temporal function.

activation_trace.role: The opening beginning of a thing makes the event an inauguration of what follows.
The resulting predication marks arrival of a new sky-state.
A door as limit or frontier gives the new state threshold force.

changed_reading.after: The breach is the inaugural threshold of a changed order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The judgment branch of ف ت ح and the category-making branch of ب و ب.
baseline_models.mechanism: An unresolved closure can be opened by judgment, and doors can organize material into categories. On this branch pairing, the sky becomes a differentiated sorting architecture: opening settles and partitions rather than only punctures.

activation_trace.role: Settling a closed dispute by judgment supplies an adjudicative kind of opening.
Division into doors, chapters, or categories supplies the sorting structure produced by that opening.

changed_reading.before: The doors are only physical portals.
changed_reading.after: The doors may also be differentiated channels produced by an act of settlement and classification.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The water-release branch of ف ت ح joined to the overhead sky and plural entrances.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opened sky can be pictured as a reservoir cover changing into multiple outlets. The plural doors distribute release through channels rather than describing one undirected tear.

activation_trace.role: Water released from an opening supplies a discharge image for the verb.
The overhead sky-cover supplies the reservoir-like upper boundary.
Plural entrances serve as distributed outlets through the boundary.

changed_reading.after: The sky becomes a manifold of release channels.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated acts of making, covering, building, placing above, and strengthening establish the upper world as an intentionally ordered enclosure. Its opening into doors is therefore a controlled reversal of a constructed function: what had covered and held becomes passage.

activation_trace.role: Opening a closed aperture supplies the reversal from enclosure to access.
The overhead cover is the constructed boundary whose function changes.
Entrances name the new passage-function of the former enclosure.
Making something into a state supplies the surah's repeated pattern of assigned cosmic functions.
Covering by clothing supplies an earlier beneficial enclosure image.
Building by joining parts makes the upper structure engineered rather than accidental.
Upper spatial placement locates the built enclosure over the audience.
Strength and solidity establish the prior resistance that opening reverses.

structural_cues: The making sequence of 78:6-13 includes a night-cover and culminates in seven strong structures built above before the passive opening of 78:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assigned cosmic functions, covering, construction, height, and solidity; I infer that 78:19 intentionally reverses the upper enclosure's function from holding to passage. A live alternative is unrelated destruction after a merely illustrative creation catalogue.

changed_reading.before: An otherwise undescribed sky suffers a breach.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately built and strengthened cover is deliberately converted from enclosure into access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier descent of water from rain-bearing clouds forms a controlled upper-to-lower release chain that produces growth. The focus opening reuses that vertical conduit image but intensifies it: the sky itself becomes a plurality of outlets rather than delivering a measured life-bearing flow.

activation_trace.role: Water released from an opening supplies the focus event's discharge mechanism.
The overhead sky-cover supplies the boundary through which release occurs.
Plural entrances function as distributed channels through that boundary.
Delivering something downward supplies the vertical direction of the earlier flow.
Rain-bearing cloud imagery supplies the upper source of the released flow.
Water supplies the material conveyed through the earlier upper-to-lower channel.
Pouring and outflow make the release abundant and directed.
Bringing a hidden thing out supplies the causal transition from water to visible growth.
Growth from the earth supplies the ordinary productive result of the controlled flow.

structural_cues: Ayat 78:14-16 give a tight descent-water-outflow-growth chain immediately before the timed day and the sky's opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descending rain, poured water, extraction, growth, and the focus root's water-release branch; I infer a shared vertical conduit whose regulated mode becomes wholesale opening. The live alternative is that rain is only evidence of power and supplies no material analogy for 78:19.

changed_reading.before: The doors are static architectural openings.
changed_reading.after: The doors are release channels, an intensified transformation of the sky's earlier life-bearing delivery system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats passive event plus فَكَانَتْ result: mountains are displaced and become mirage. The parallel makes both stable cosmic fixtures undergo functional state-change. Sky does not merely contain opened doors; its continuity becomes aperture just as mountain solidity becomes deceptive appearance.

activation_trace.role: Opening a closed surface supplies loss of the sky's continuity.
Result predication makes doors the resulting sky-state.
Entrances name the new spatial character of the sky.
Removal and displacement undo the mountains' fixed placement.
A gathered, elevated solidity supplies the stable fixture being undone.
The repeated result predication formally pairs the mountain change with the sky change.
A water-like mirage supplies the mountains' replacement state of deceptive non-solidity.

structural_cues: 78:19 and 78:20 form consecutive passive clauses with the same فَكَانَتْ plus indefinite accusative result pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact syntactic parallelism and opposite material outcomes; I infer coordinated deconstruction of continuity and solidity. A live alternative is that the two clauses simply list independent portents without inviting a shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Open doors appear within an otherwise surviving sky.
changed_reading.after: The sky's continuous surface is replaced by aperture, paired with the replacement of mountain solidity by mirage.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed day of separation gathers people in cohorts, places a watched route before limit-crossers, assigns a return destination, and gives a fitting recompense. The sky's adjudicative opening into categorized doors becomes routing infrastructure: plural gates separate assembled groups toward corresponding outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Judgment that settles a closure supplies the adjudicative force of opening.
Division into categories supplies differentiated channels for sorting.
Doors as limits or frontiers supply thresholds between outcomes.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the event's sorting mandate.
An appointed time fixes when the sorting mechanism activates.
Groups of people supply the plural units to be routed.
A watched place or road supplies controlled destination infrastructure.
Crossing the limit in disobedience identifies one class relative to the gates' frontier function.
Return to a destination supplies the terminus of one routed path.
Recompense corresponding to action supplies the output of adjudication.
Agreement and fit make the routed outcome correspond to its class.

structural_cues: The focus stands between the announced day of separation and the watched return-place, while cohorts, recompense, and fit develop the sorting sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judgment, appointment, cohorts, a watched route, limit-crossers, return, and fitting recompense; I supply the arrow that cohorts pass through differentiated sky-gates toward outcomes. The live alternative is that the gates are only a portent and routing begins elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: The plural doors are undifferentiated openings.
changed_reading.after: They are adjudicative sorting gates that convert assembled cohorts into destination-bound classes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from a disputed report to promised knowing, denial of signs, exhaustive enumeration in a record, and final seeing. The sky's opening therefore has an epistemic function alongside its physical one: concealed and disputed reality becomes publicly inspectable and differentiated.

activation_trace.role: Opening by insight or disclosure supplies the transition from hiddenness to knowledge.
The split mapping's sign read by discerning observation makes the sky a legible evidentiary surface.
Categorized doors supply differentiation within what is disclosed.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies the initially mediated object of dispute.
Taking divergent paths supplies the report's contested reception.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower supplies the promised reversal of uncertainty.
Falsehood opposed to truth supplies the failed stance that disclosure overturns.
A visible sign supplies evidence that had been denied.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies completeness of the disclosed evidence.
An ordered written record supplies a durable form for the evidence.
Directed sight or insight supplies the final first-person inspection of what had been disputed.

structural_cues: The opening question and doubled 'they will know' are answered downstream by denied signs, exhaustive record, and the person's final looking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispute, future knowing, denied signs, enumeration, record, and final inspection; I infer that the opened sky participates in converting report into public evidence. A live alternative is that epistemic resolution results from judgment generally, not from the sky event specifically.

changed_reading.before: The sky opening is only something spectators witness.
changed_reading.after: The opened sky is itself part of the evidentiary unveiling that makes a disputed report inspectable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Late in the surah, address is not possessed, ranks stand, and intelligible speech occurs only by permission and correctness. Read back into the focus, keys and doorkeepers become live door-images: opening does not imply unrestricted passage but an authorized court with controlled thresholds.

activation_trace.role: A key or means of access supplies authorization rather than mere physical openness.
The door-keeper image supplies controlled admission at the plural thresholds.
Possession and power of disposal, here denied, define who does not control access to address.
Reciprocal address supplies the court-like access that cannot be independently claimed.
Bodily standing supplies the assembled court posture.
Alignment in a straight rank supplies ordered rather than free movement.
Intelligible speech between parties supplies the action under restriction.
Explicit permission supplies the gatekeeping rule.
Correctness opposed to error supplies the condition governing permitted speech.

structural_cues: 78:37-38 narrows possession of address into ranked silence and then into permission-conditioned correct speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied control, ranked standing, silence, permission, and correctness; I infer that the focus doors participate in the same controlled-access order. The live alternative is that the doors regulate movement only and have no relation to speech authorization.

changed_reading.before: Once opened, the doors imply unrestricted access.
changed_reading.after: The opened doors remain jurisdictional thresholds whose use depends on authorization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The compact claim that every thing is exhaustively enumerated as a record activates the category sense of doors. The sky becoming doors can be read as cosmic tabulation: one continuous domain is articulated into discrete entries or chapters through which the complete order is manifested.

activation_trace.role: Division into chapters or categories supplies the focus image of articulated entries.
Result predication makes this articulation a new state of the sky.
Completeness and total inclusion supply the record's scope.
Each knowable thing supplies the unit included in the total order.
Counting to exhaustion supplies the operation that discretizes the whole.
Entry into a register or class supplies the catalogue structure mirrored by the doors.

structural_cues: The four-word sequence 'every thing - enumerated it - as a record' compresses totality, units, operation, and organized result into 78:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive enumeration and registration, while the focus branch supplies chaptering; I infer a structural analogy between doors and entries in a complete catalogue. The live alternative is that ب و ب is purely architectural and كتابًا purely documentary.

changed_reading.before: The plural simply counts many openings.
changed_reading.after: The plurality articulates the sky into discrete, registered categories of manifestation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beneficial covering appears as the night's garment and the garden hidden by foliage, while the final denier is characterized by covering truth. Against this field, opening the overhead cover becomes terminal uncovering: both sheltering concealment and culpable concealment cease to protect from exposure.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure and removal of inner closure supply the antithesis to covering.
The overhead cover supplies the largest sheltering layer to be opened.
Clothing as cover supplies a beneficial form of concealment earlier in the surah.
A garden hidden by trees supplies fertile protective concealment.
Covering the truth supplies culpable concealment exposed at the end.

structural_cues: Covering images occur in the creation catalogue and the final human designation, bracketing the sky's explicit opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies garment-cover, hidden garden, truth-covering, and focus disclosure; I infer an antithetical uncovering arc in which protective and culpable covers both lose efficacy. The live alternative is that the three covering roots remain unrelated lexical domains.

changed_reading.before: Opening alters only the sky's physical state.
changed_reading.after: Opening terminates a surah-wide economy of cover, making concealment unavailable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant و س م and س م م mappings carried under the focus sky root, reading marks and narrow perforations into the sky. It remains valid as an exploratory material image because both citations attach to the focus word سَّمَاء and converge with plural doors; downstream prose should label it a split-root activation, not a lexical claim about the ordinary sense of سماء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sky's split mapped branches for a visible identifying mark and a narrow opening, joined to أَبْوَابًا.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark makes each opening legible on the sky-surface.
A narrow entry perforation supplies a membrane-like material form for the opening.
Plural entrances scale the marked perforation into a field of access points.

changed_reading.before: The sky opens through generic large doors.
changed_reading.after: The sky reads as a marked membrane perforated by many identifiable entry points.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ordinary paraphrase tends to preserve an intact sky containing doors, whereas the singular subject takes plural doors as its own predicate. It remains tightly anchored in فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَابًا and the entrance/category branches; downstream prose should present it as a grammatical-material construal, not settle the ontology of the sky.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The singular sky is the subject of resultative فَكَانَتْ with plural أَبْوَابًا as predicate.

activation_trace.role: Opening the closed surface initiates loss of continuity.
Predicated occurrence assigns the plural result directly to the singular sky.
Entrances supply the distributed spatial state replacing continuity.
Division into categories explains how one domain can become a plurality.

changed_reading.before: Doors are installed or revealed in an intact sky.
changed_reading.after: Door-ness becomes the sky's distributed state, replacing its continuous enclosure.

strongest_changes: The preceding construction catalogue turns the opening into a deliberate reversal from strong enclosure to passage.
The exact 78:19-20 resultative parallel makes sky-continuity and mountain-solidity undergo paired deconstruction.
The day of separation, cohorts, watched route, return, and fitting recompense turn plural doors into adjudicative sorting gates.
The rain chain activates a material reading of the doors as intensified upper-to-lower release channels.
The report-to-record-to-seeing arc gives the physical opening an evidentiary disclosure function.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the same four-word focus mechanism operate simultaneously as architecture, phase threshold, hydraulic manifold, sorting system, evidentiary unveiling, and controlled court access. The singular-sky/plural-door result and the split mapped sky branches preserved two especially easy-to-lose material readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The text does not state that assembled cohorts physically pass through the sky doors; that routing arrow remains abductive.
The rain-release analogy is materially coherent but may be only a contrast with ordinary provision rather than the mechanism of 78:19.
The marked-membrane reading depends on non-dominant split-root inventories and must remain exploratory.
The category and record senses may describe analogous organization without identifying the doors as literal catalogue entries.
Controlled speech access may share the doors' jurisdictional order without being mediated by those doors.
